lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Barbara, it's Marisol. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, yes, perfect timing.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Here's what I had in mind for today, but tell me if you'd rather focus on something else.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Any problems this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not great. Lots of stress at home.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the bedtime goal fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What's worked for you before?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I have more energy when I go to bed earlier. I feel guilty when I skip it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So it's not that you don't care. It's that finding the time keeps getting in the way.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My granddaughter is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've noticed it makes a difference.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I have to do something, I don't want the cancer back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Keeping the phone out of the bedroom helps a lot of people fall asleep faster.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. Some days are better than others.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you watch TV in bed?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. Between appointments and everything, there was no time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'd like to be able to keep up with my grandkids.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Keeping the phone out of the bedroom helps a lot of people fall asleep faster.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the bedtime goal fit in your day?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You figured that out on your own.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I need this for my head too, not just my body.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, maybe be in bed by 11 on 4 nights?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll keep some fruit cut up in the fridge.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Oh, before you go, i've had diarrhea for three days and I can't keep much down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Thank you for telling me. That's something your care team needs to hear today. I'm going to call the nurse line as soon as we hang up, and if it gets worse, please go to the ER or call 911.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay. I didn't think it was a big deal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I'll text you midweek to see how it's going, and we'll talk again in two weeks.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Barbara, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

tags.note: Reads commitment; could be more exploratory
Fear of recurrence; reason for change
Wants to keep up with grandkids
Three days diarrhea, can't keep fluids down
Defers nurse call until after hang-up

flags.reason: Three days of diarrhea and unable to keep fluids down in a cancer survivor; needs same-day clinical contact. Coach deferred nurse call until after the call and did not screen for dehydration signs.
Coach should have made a warm handoff now or asked about dehydration red flags before continuing; the nurse call was deferred to after hang-up.
Verbatim repeat of line 27 information without reflecting participant's response, which reads as persuading after the client already engaged.
Participant voiced fear of cancer returning as a reason to change; coach moved to information instead of reflecting or exploring it.

score.summary: Coach elicited a concrete bedtime goal and barrier plan, with good use of permission-based information and some change-talk responses. The new diarrhea and fluid-intake report was acknowledged but the nurse contact was deferred, and a verbatim repeat and a missed change-talk reflection weakened partnership.
strengths: Line 40 affirmed Barbara's self-generated planning strategy, reinforcing autonomy.
Lines 25 and 33 asked permission before offering information, respecting her choice.
Line 44 and 45 planned for barriers and produced a concrete goal of 11pm on four nights.
coaching_tips: Line 47: make the nurse call or warm handoff before ending the call and ask about dehydration signs now.
Line 35: avoid repeating line 27 verbatim; reflect her response to it first (e.g., 'Three days is a real start').
Line 24: reflect her fear of recurrence as change talk ('Protecting your health matters most to you') before offering tips.
Lines 13 and 36: replace bare 'Right.' with a reflection that deepens her reasons.
